source.prompt: Create a compact production-art CANDIDATE effects atlas for the game Umbral, based on the leaf weapons in the two attached approved hare designs. This is ONLY detached foliage and leaf-cut VFX, no characters. Preserve their visual language: sharp lanceolate fern/olive green leaves, pale yellow-green central veins, dark green-black thin outline, simple confident cel-painted planes, soft upper-left light, readable at 24–64 game pixels. Organic blades, not steel, no handles. Four separated objects in an exact 2 by 2 grid on a square canvas, TRUE transparent alpha. Each object must stay inside its equal quadrant with ample clear margin, not touching or overlapping another quadrant. Top-left: ONE narrow detached pointed leaf blade, horizontal, stem/base at LEFT and sharp tip at RIGHT, straight central vein, mostly green with a warm yellow-green edge. Top-right: ONE broad subtly curved detached guard leaf, also base LEFT tip RIGHT, proportion around 2.5 to 1. Bottom-left: ONE crisp curved green cutting crescent shaped from 3 overlapping narrow leaf planes, opening toward the RIGHT, no circular glow, no complete ring, only a compact slash silhouette. Bottom-right: ONE asymmetric contact burst made from 6 small detached green leaf shards and 2 short pale yellow-green cut strokes, directed mainly toward the RIGHT, sparse clear negative space. No ground, shadows, background color, scene, UI, frames, dividing lines, labels, text, numbers, signatures, duplicate grids, blur or glowing fireballs. This atlas is green physical foliage with crisp contour and true transparent pixels, consistent with the reference blades. Do not include rabbits or any anatomy.

source.prompt:
Create ONE transparent PNG sprite atlas for an ORIGINAL pixel-art monster game named Umbral. This is actual reusable character art, NOT a scene or UI or diagram. EXACTLY 7 full-body creatures in a perfectly regular grid of FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, all cells same size; last bottom-right cell EMPTY TRANSPARENT. Landscape atlas approx 2048x1024. Do not draw grid lines or labels; every cell's background is fully transparent with generous transparent padding on all sides. Every sprite centered horizontally in its cell, feet aligned to a common baseline at 85% cell height, whole silhouette within inner 80% of cell. No overlap between cells. Characters occupy roughly 65-75% cell height; NO ground shadows, NO scenery, NO text. Side/three-quarter view appropriate to a slightly elevated horizontal battle camera. Cohesive crisp pixel art with bold near-black colored outlines, deliberate small square pixel clusters, clean 3-5 tones per material, charming highly memorable silhouettes reminiscent of the readability of classic handheld monster games, but entirely original species. A sprite should read at 100px tall. Bright elemental accents and expressive eyes. No blur or painted gradients, no photorealism, no 3D. source.prompt:
Create a clean transparent production sprite sheet of the EXACT hare character in the attached cutout: Folife, intermediate leaf hare, NOT a baby and NOT a final evolution. Keep its exact adult-intermediate proportions, low quadrupedal body, broad muscular hindquarters, long ears (one green serrated leaf covering the backward ear; one upright brown ear with leaf bud), leafy neck/shoulder collar, little leaf tail, brown/olive fur, cream muzzle and paws, amber eye, yellow-green chevron on thigh, single short green leaf dagger held by one forepaw. Same painterly cel shading, bold dark contour and upper-left light as the cutout.
OUTPUT: 12 full-body poses in one precise regular 4-column by 3-row grid. 1448 by 1086 pixel sheet, 362 by 362 equal cells. Every character stays facing RIGHT. All twelve figures have the same body proportions, zoom, camera, palette and root x position within their cells. Keep each figure fully inside its own cell with clear transparent margins. No labels or drawn grid.
Rows 1 and 2: eight successive genuinely different walking poses forming a small low bunny-step loop in place. Change limb joint positions, not just the entire image. Start neutral crouch, push back one large hind foot, reach the free forepaw, recover/tuck hind feet, alternate the next hind-foot push, return to neutral. One forepaw continuously holds the short leaf dagger off the ground, the other free forepaw can step. Keep the low hare anatomy; no biped or humanoid stance. Tiny vertical bounce only, avoid a dramatic jump. Ear leaves and collar react a little to the gait. Frame 8 closely approaches frame 1. Grounded foot contact has a consistent baseline near the bottom of every cell.
Row 3: four successive distinct reversible knockout poses. First stagger with closed eye and drooping ears; second lowers/folds foreleg; third settles onto side with folded hindlegs; fourth rests fully on its side with closed eye, drooped ears, limbs tucked, leaf collar and short dagger visible. No blood, wounds or damage. Keep the exact same character identity and scale.
ALPHA REQUIREMENT: The empty area around and BETWEEN characters must be fully transparent alpha=0. ALL character interiors fully opaque. Clean antialiased silhouette boundaries only. No partially transparent clouds, fog, smoke, dither, colored fringe, aura, particles, cast shadow, ground, background texture, gradient, paper, lighting backdrop or raster checkerboard. No red or bright outline accents. The only edges are the source character's dark contour. Use native transparent background output, not a drawn background. No text, numbers, watermark, scenery, borders or extra subjects.
